Upstream: [stoatworks-labs/UnMapper](https://github.com/stoatworks-labs/UnMapper/tree/459e3319399a8570619af738e271d71a07c593c3), full commit `459e3319399a8570619af738e271d71a07c593c3`. | Local file | Source file | Source Git blob | Origin and transfer |
|---|---|---|---|
| arena-preset.xml | resolume-arena-preset.xml | `af6987a4c8ccc0de0c26b2cb9873e7c1a0f52236` | ADAPT actual Arena 7.27.0 revision 14395 preset; replace project/screen/slice labels and unique IDs with fixture labels/IDs; geometry and Params unchanged |
| arena-preferences.xml | resolume-arena-preferences.xml | `3c31c540c4136bd01bb5ad9b22fb7722264c8c98` | ADAPT actual Arena preferences; replace screen/device labels, unique IDs and machine-specific idHash; geometry and capture-settings values unchanged |
| pixel-peeker-generated.xml | pixel-peeker-export.xml | `7a121f0b34243c72a2b758d666cf5aed91bfc348` | TAKE generated by the independent pixel-peeker writer; only remove the extra trailing blank line, if present. This was not generated by Arena |
| warp-synthetic.xml | warped-lattice-synthetic.xml | `f9d43dfeb61dc6c45c30469679b0598cd2fb015c` | TAKE hand-authored upstream warp based on the Arena preset; retain the SYNTHETIC header and all control points; normalize final blank lines. This was not generated by Arena |
| ledmap-native-golden.xml | LedMAP test fixture | n/a | Created by this stage for a two-slice project with signed chart-frame origin, escaped names and disabled slice; reviewed against pinned native vertex/Warper/device structure |

The upstream origin statements are documented in `crates/unmapper-resolume/src/lib.rs` (blob `825cf28d318ddbc8793c95bdef480257297b7e15`) and `tests/fixtures.rs` (blob `264a48e9331326f6d66ffc145fe8535f9b24a929`) at that same commit. Fixture-reading tests establish that LedMAP reads these files. They do not establish that LedMAP's generated XML has been loaded by Arena. No live Arena compatibility is claimed.

Tests: `packages/app/test/resolume-native.test.ts`; Electron smoke independently parses the generated preset with Chromium DOMParser and checks its source coordinates against the actual Composition PNG frame. Additional malformed/unsupported variants are constructed in tests, not described as real Arena files.

Reproduce: fetch each pinned source text, make only the substitutions listed above, and normalize final blank lines. Full source URLs and adapter adaptation records are in [external-source-audit.md](../../../../../docs/licenses/external-source-audit.md). B.L.I.N.K material is absent.

Exact preset substitutions: `output_map_1` → `fixture-preset`; `OUTPUT MAP 1` → `Fixture Virtual`; `1783549962336`/`1783549962337`/`1783549962338`/`1783549962339` → `2001`/`2002`/`2003`/`2004`; Param values `SL ` → `Left`, `SR` → `Right`, `trailer` → `Center`.

Exact preferences substitutions: `Trailer Screen` → `Fixture Capture`; `1784373714049` → `1001`; `1784373714063` → `1002`; `DeckLink_DeckLink Duo (2)` → `Fixture Capture Device`; `15893004103272075612` → `0`. Other files receive no content substitutions. XML fixture line endings are pinned to LF in .gitattributes.
